agent_patch:
diff --git a/apply_fix.py b/apply_fix.py
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..f4e690e7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apply_fix.py
@@ -0,0 +1,142 @@
+
+import os
+
+def replace_in_file(filepath, old_text, new_text):
+    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
+        content = f.read()
+    
+    new_content = content.replace(old_text, new_text)
+    
+    with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
+        f.write(new_content)
+
+# Fix fastapi/applications.py - __init__ parameters
+old_text_1 = """        license_info: Annotated[
+            Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, Any]]],
+            Doc(
+                \"\"\"
+                A dictionary with the license information for the exposed API.
+
+                It can contain several fields.
+
+                * `name`: (`str`) **REQUIRED** (if a `license_info` is set). The
+                    license name used for the API.
+                * `identifier`: (`str`) An [SPDX](https://spdx.dev/) license expression
+                    for the API. The `identifier` field is mutually exclusive of the `url`
+                    field. Available since OpenAPI 3.1.0, FastAPI 0.99.0.
+                * `url`: (`str`) A URL to the license used for the API. This MUST be
+                    the format of a URL.
+
+                It will be added to the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
+
+                Read more at the
+                [FastAPI docs for Metadata and Docs URLs](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/metadata/#metadata-for-api).
+
+                **Example**
+
+                ```python
+                app = FastAPI(
+                    license_info={
+                        "name": "Apache 2.0",
+                        "url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html",
+                    }
+                )
+                ```
+                \"\"\"
+            ),
+        ] = None,"""
+
+new_text_1 = """        license_info: Annotated[
+            Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, Any]]],
+            Doc(
+                \"\"\"
+                A dictionary with the license information for the exposed API.
+
+                It can contain several fields.
+
+                * `name`: (`str`) **REQUIRED** (if a `license_info` is set). The
+                    license name used for the API.
+                * `identifier`: (`str`) An [SPDX](https://spdx.dev/) license expression
+                    for the API. The `identifier` field is mutually exclusive of the `url`
+                    field. Available since OpenAPI 3.1.0, FastAPI 0.99.0.
+                * `url`: (`str`) A URL to the license used for the API. This MUST be
+                    the format of a URL.
+
+                It will be added to the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
+
+                Read more at the
+                [FastAPI docs for Metadata and Docs URLs](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/metadata/#metadata-for-api).
+
+                **Example**
+
+                ```python
+                app = FastAPI(
+                    license_info={
+                        "name": "Apache 2.0",
+                        "url": "https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html",
+                    }
+                )
+                ```
+                \"\"\"
+            ),
+        ] = None,
+        external_docs: Annotated[
+            Optional[Dict[str, str]],
+            Doc(
+                \"\"\"
+                External documentation for the API.
+
+                It should be a dictionary with the following fields:
+                * `description`: (`str`) A short description of the documentation.
+                * `url`: (`str`) A URL to the external documentation.
+
+                It will be added to the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
+
+                Read more at the
+                [FastAPI docs for Metadata and Docs URLs](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/metadata/#metadata-for-api).
+
+                **Example**
+
+                ```python
+                app = FastAPI(
+                    external_docs={
+                        "description": "External API Documentation",
+                        "url": "https://example.com/docs",
+                    }
+                )
+                ```
+                \"\"\"
+            ),
+        ] = None,"""
+
+# Fix fastapi/applications.py - __init__ body
+old_text_2 = "        self.license_info = license_info"
+new_text_2 = "        self.license_info = license_info\n        self.external_docs = external_docs"
+
+# Fix fastapi/applications.py - openapi() method
+old_text_3 = """                license_info=self.license_info,
+                routes=self.routes,"""
+new_text_3 = """                license_info=self.license_info,
+                external_docs=self.external_docs,
+                routes=self.routes,"""
+
+# Fix fastapi/openapi/utils.py - get_openapi signature
+old_text_4 = """    license_info: Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, Any]]] = None,
+    separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True,"""
+new_text_4 = """    license_info: Optional[Dict[str, Union[str, Any]]] = None,
+    external_docs: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
+    separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True,"""
+
+# Fix fastapi/openapi/utils.py - get_openapi body
+old_text_5 = """    if license_info:
+        info["license"] = license_info"""
+new_text_5 = """    if license_info:
+        info["license"] = license_info
+    if external_docs:
+        info["externalDocs"] = external_docs"""
+
+replace_in_file('fastapi/applications.py', old_text_1, new_text_1)
+replace_in_file('fastapi/applications.py', old_text_2, new_text_2)
+replace_in_file('fastapi/applications.py', old_text_3, new_text_3)
+replace_in_file('fastapi/openapi/utils.py', old_text_4, new_text_4)
+replace_in_file('fastapi/openapi/utils.py', old_text_5, new_text_5)
